# Roleplay Rule 7 ## Faction Role Rules
[color=#d93c3c][bold]You should not be abandoning your role in a faction without valid RP reason[/bold][/color].
[color=#b8860b][bold]As a faction member, you should assume that:[/bold][/color] - Your character is a mentally stable individual. - Your character isn't part of any other groups that would take priority over your faction duties (such as religious groups, or acting under the orders of a company instead of your faction). - You should listen to your superiors in most cases. This does not mean listen to your superiors when they order you to shoot a civilian without reason, and you should prioritize RP rules over this.
Various examples of [color=#d93c3c][bold]Role Abandonment[/bold][/color] could be:
-- Giving the other faction your gear, access or intel, or fighting for them against your own faction. Talking and trading with them while the war level is COLD is [color=#2e9e4f]fine[/color] (further highlighted in Conflict Rule One). -- Starting a fight with the other faction against orders. -- Joining a faction only for its ships, gear, or access, and ignoring your duties to that faction (such as joining TSF/PDV and going out to do Botany). Your actions should be for the benefit of your faction and cause, not yourself.
[italic][color=#2e9e4f]Don't be surprised if you get killed by another faction member after ignoring your radio for 3 hours.[/color][/italic]
